mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP growth above 3% over three consecutive quarters signals a strengthening economic expansion, which typically leads to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDP growth exceeds 3% for three quarters but S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the industrial production index below its 12-month moving average by more than 1% signals a contraction in manufacturing activity, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If industrial production declines below its 12-month moving average by more than 1% but S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, the hypothesis is falsified.
